title: Classic Tetris Pro
description: Rotate and drop crisp falling tetrominoes to clear four-line Tetrises in silky-smooth arcade physics—pure timeless block-stacking mastery.
controls: Tap rotate, left, right, and drop buttons (or arrow keys) to fit falling blocks into complete horizontal lines.

zh-CN.title: 经典俄罗斯方块
zh-CN.description: 国民永恒益智经典俄罗斯方块：旋转落块严丝合缝码齐整行瞬间消除，丝滑手感随时来一局消磨时光！
zh-CN.controls: 点击左右移动、旋转与速降按钮将下落方块码齐整行即可消除得分。
